audit_items.proof_trace: The three writes (members insert L284, auth metadata update L301, member_team_relations insert L315) are sequential independent awaits with no DB transaction. The member_team_relations error handler (L316-318) only logs; it never rolls back the committed members row, and the function unconditionally returns { error: null } at L326. Proof of atomicity fails: partial state (member row without team relations) is silently committed and reported as success.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An attacker submits team_ids containing a non-existent or constraint-violating team_id; the members insert commits successfully, but the member_team_relations insert throws a FK violation that is swallowed — leaving the member registered without any team assignment while the UI reports success.
